locations.prompt_summary: An ancient, primeval forest. Towering, gnarled trees with thick moss-covered trunks reach high into a dappled canopy. Sunlight filters through the dense foliage, creating dramatic shafts of light on the forest floor. The ground is covered with fallen leaves, ferns, and decaying logs, suggesting immense age and untouched nature. A faint mist hangs low, adding to the mystical atmosphere.

Soft, diffused daylight filters through the high canopy, illuminating patches of moss and fallen leaves on the forest floor, creating a serene, empty expanse.
